gaps.what: The 1601 return of the Danube forts to the Ottomans stays a confidence-1 bridge (Long Turkish War page silent); Amlas, Fagaras and Ciceu undated and undrawn; Rovine is 1394 on the Wallachia and Mircea I pages and 17 May 1395 on the Battle of Rovine page; the Regulamentul Organic page puts the 1848-1851 occupations' start in September 1849, the Revolution page in September 1848

No page dates the Serbian conquest of Albania or its secession (Stefan Uros V, Karl Thopia, Balsic and Despotate of Epirus pages opened); Albania leaves only in a confidence-1 loss of 1371 (Maritsa page, 'by 1371'); the December 1371 end of the Ottoman contest is a bridge (Prince Marko page silent); no km2 on any page

No page names an Angevin seat for 1289-1303 and 1369-1383 (Corfu used as a reading); Butrint after 1304-1305 and Corfu's holder between 1294 and 1386 are not named; Corfu in the 1375 shape is a bridge; no area on any page

Shape geometry unverified (the Syrmia article is the region page); what happened to the land after Dragutin's death in 1316 (Milutin's undated defeat of Vladislav before 1321, Charles Robert's campaign of 1319) and whether Dragutin lost Macva to Darman and Kudelin in 1290-1292 are on none of the pages opened; the year Stephen II of Bosnia took Usora and Soli is not given (1325 used)

No boundaries or area on the page; who held Fier after 1372 and when Berat fell to the Muzaka is not dated (footnote 15 of the page puts Berat in the 1372 dowry, the main text does not); the Despotate of Epirus relation is undated

problems: Repair run of 2026-10-25 for the five dossiers the reviewer failed; moravian-serbia (verdict thin) was not touched, so events_total and sources_total cover the five dossiers in dossiers_written only (the original report's moravian-serbia counts still stand).

Disagreement with the reviewer (serbian-empire): Albania stays in the 1356-1371 keyframe (minus the Valona counties) and leaves in a confidence-1 loss of 1371 to albanian-principalities, because no page opened dates the secession earlier and the Balsic page has the brothers acknowledged in Uros's edicts (r. 1355-1371); the reviewer's alternative (a dated loss) could not be sourced.

Disagreement (house-of-anjou-sicily): the 1282 date of the loss of the Albanian interior is kept, because the cited Capetian House page says 'by 1282' (the Kingdom of Albania page says 'by 1281'); the despotate-of-epirus events of 1294, 1307 and 1331 (Philip of Taranto's dowry fortresses, the compromise, Walter of Brienne's Vonitsa and Leucas) were not mirrored: they are Taranto lands that no shape of this row draws, and despotate-of-epirus (eu-05) should change those counterparts; only the 1279 gain and the 1304 loss of Butrint are mirrored.

Cross-dossier requests: kingdom-of-sicily (eu-12) /ledger/16 names kingdom-of-naples as the loser of Malta in 1283 and should name house-of-anjou-sicily, which is now the pair of this row's loss (counterpart kingdom-of-sicily); banate-of-bosnia should gain Usora and Soli from kingdom-of-syrmia in 1325; albanian-principalities should record the 1371 gain of Albania from serbian-empire and the 1372 gains of Berat and Fier from principality-of-valona; catalan-company already has the 1348 loss mirrored by a new serbian-empire gain; habsburg-monarchy (eu-09) should carry the occupation of Wallachia 1789-1791 (its /ledger/105 mentions Bucharest); russian-empire (eu-17) and ottoman-empire (me-10) should carry the mirror occupations of Wallachia 1828-1834, 1848-1851 and 1853-1854; kingdom-of-hungary (eu-15) may carry a vassal tint for Usora and Soli (Dragutin 'continued to rule them as a Hungarian vassal').
New events with an Ottoman occupation pair for Wallachia 1848-1851 overlap the Russian pair of the same dates (the pages call it a joint occupation): the renderer may merge them.

Standing issues of the original report: kingdom-of-serbia (eu-18) should end in 1346 so it is not double-drawn with serbian-empire; principality-of-valona-and-kanina is merged into principality-of-valona and should get no separate dossier; Michael the Brave's occupations of Transylvania and Moldavia need reverse events; principality-of-achaea (eu-05) must agree with the Achaea shapes of house-of-anjou-sicily (now clipped to the Peloponnese in 1375-1383).

Thin items tried: Wallachia (all six pages tried, five dated: 1828, 1834, 1848, 1853, 1854; the 1601 forts and Amlas/Fagaras stay open), serbian-empire (Karl Thopia and Prince Marko pages: silent), anjou (Corfu and Achaea pages: Corfu 1294 and 1386, Achaea 'Peloponnese' settled), syrmia (Vladislav II and Darman and Kudelin pages settled Usora/Soli's fate and Braničevo's holders; the 1282 start is explained in the dossier notes).
Page budgets were exceeded by the repair (new pages cited: Wallachia 9, Serbian Empire 5, Anjou-Sicily 2, Syrmia 2); the gazetteer lacks Kastoria, Butrint, Kaninë, Rudnik, Debrc.
